title: E-Commerce: How Five CPG Brands Are Winning
summary: We evaluated 24 CPG brands across the digital attributes that matter most for long-term go-to-market success accross the e-commerce dimension.
body_markdown:
Forrester recently released the report,


[Digital Go-To-Market Review: CPG Brands, 2026](https://www.forrester.com/report/digital-go-to-market-review-cpg-brands-2026/RES200934) . In this review, we examined 24 CPG brands across the digital attributes that matter most for long-term go-to-market success. For the e-commerce dimension, we reviewed direct-to-consumer (DTC) buyability and Amazon storefront presence.


These five CPG brands are winning in e-commerce:


- **Similac** earned top marks for its strong DTC experience, extensive parent resources, and robust loyalty program.


- **Purina** stood out with its myPurina app, subscription options, loyalty benefits, and personalized recommendations.


- **Hello** distinguished itself through DTC purchasing capabilities and was one of the few brands in our review that offered a replenishment subscription program.


- **Tide** demonstrated a best-in-class Amazon presence with a highly branded storefront and seamless product navigation.


- **Kleenex** excelled on Amazon through its use of rich media and a product finder tool.
